sloka: राघवस्त्वथ यातेषु तपस्विषु विचिन्तयन् ।न तत्रारोचयद्वासं कारणैर्बहुभिस्तदा ॥ २.११७.१॥
transliteration: rāghavastvatha yāteṣu tapasviṣu vicintayan ।na tatrārocayadvāsaṁ kāraṇairbahubhistadā ॥ 2.117.1॥

translations.english: When the ascetics had departed, Rama thought over the matter well and did not like to reside there for many reasons.
